title: Inbox - Holloway Mail
completeLines: Outreach campaigns are awaiting your approval.

messages.subject: Welcome back to your shift
messages.body:
Hello, valued Operator!

Thank you for joining the late shift again. Please reconcile your ledger, respond to all correspondence and approve pending outreach before 00:00.

Every colleague you interact with tonight will rate you. Your rating is visible to everyone.

Remember: Productivity is Presence.

HR

replies.text: So grateful to be here! Let's make it a great one!

messages.subject: Scheduled maintenance tonight
messages.body:
Systems will be restarted at the end of this shift. Unsaved work will be lost. Please do not power off Workstation 13 under any circumstances.

IT

replies.text: Thank you SO much for keeping us running!
Why would I power it off?

messages.subject: RE: Q3 ledger variance
messages.body:
Hi!

The Q3 numbers still don't reconcile. Can you take another pass at the ledger tonight? I know you've looked at it before.

Dana

replies.text: Anything for you, Dana! Love working with you!

messages.subject: Overhead light, Floor 13
messages.body:
We are aware the overhead light in your section flickers. A ticket has been open since Round 1. There is no Floor 13 on our building plans, but we will send someone.

Facilities

replies.text: Thanks, no rush at all! You're the best!
What do you mean, no Floor 13?

messages.subject: RE: RE: lunch?
messages.body:
Still on for lunch tomorrow? You said yes last time.

And the time before that.

M

replies.text: Yes!! Wouldn't miss it for the world!

messages.subject: Mandatory: Presence Policy
messages.body:
A reminder that all time away from your screen is logged by the productivity monitor and deducted from your rating.

There is nothing behind you that requires your attention.

HR

replies.text: Thank you for keeping me present!

messages.subject: RE: RE: RE: Q3 ledger variance
messages.body:
You sent me this exact reply already.

Word for word. Same timestamp. Is your mail client looping?

Dana

replies.text: So sorry Dana! Fixing it right now!
Let me circle back on that.

messages.subject: Your automatic reply
messages.body:
The following automatic reply was generated on your behalf in each of the previous 12 rounds:

    "{lastReply}"

It was rated well. No action is required.

messages.subject: Unusual activity at Workstation 13
messages.body:
Our logs show continuous keyboard input at Workstation 13, but the badge reader shows nobody entered the building tonight.

Can you confirm you are at your desk?

IT

messages.subject: RE: RE: RE: RE: lunch?
messages.body:
I walked past your cubicle a minute ago. The chair was empty.

But the keyboard was still going.

M

replies.text: Ha! Must have been on a break!

messages.subject: (no subject)
messages.body:
is anyone else still here

the lights stopped flickering on my side

what round are you on

dont rate me back

replies.text: Reported for misuse of mail. Have a great night!

messages.subject: Exit interview: Round 12
messages.body:
Thank you for your service in Round 12. Your final rating has been archived.

Your replacement is already at their desk and has completed onboarding. They will not notice you.

HR

messages.subject: Please finish your tasks
messages.body:
Finish your work.

Then we can talk.
